evidence_basis.why_not_analyst_upside: Sorting a universe by analyst-implied upside is the obvious move and it is the one the lab has measured as NEGATIVE: t -3.6 in large/mid and -7.2 in small. The funnel records it for sizing and refuses to rank on it.
